div.h2:
Like the Hummingbird,
You Are Built to Thrive

div.span: This is a regulated system: steady and calm. Tap to see stress.

div.p: The hummingbird beats its wings 200 times a minute — yet is never depleted. It moves with precision, vibrancy and grace. That's the natural state your nervous system is built for.
Chronic stress and unprocessed tension pull us away from that balance. HummingBeing helps you release what's been building — and find your way back to the energy that's always been there.
A gentle, body-led process that meets you exactly where you are.
A relaxed 30-minute chat with Isabelle to explore what you're carrying and which practice might feel right for you.
Work 1:1 with Isabelle in supervised sessions designed to gently activate your body's natural release mechanisms.
After 3–4 sessions most people can practice on their own — a simple tool you can use for the rest of your life.
Continued support as you integrate new patterns of resilience into daily life, work and relationships.

div.h2: You Don't Need a Particular Story

div.p: HummingBeing is for anyone who feels something is off — even if they can't quite name it. You don't need to be in crisis. You just need to feel the quiet pull to come back to yourself.

div.p: TRE™ (Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises) is a short sequence of simple exercises designed to activate the body’s natural tremor reflex, which many people find helps release stress and tension. It was developed by Dr David Berceli. TRE™ is a self-help practice rather than a therapy, and you can stop the tremors at any time.

TRE™ suits anyone who wants a simple, body-based way to manage stress: busy professionals, leaders, coaches, therapists, carers and people recovering from burnout. No fitness level or experience is needed. Some people should speak to a doctor or therapist first, so read Is TRE™ safe? before you start.

summary.h3: Are TRE™ sessions online or in person?

div.p: Both. Every session is available online via Zoom, wherever you are in the world, and in-person sessions are available in Singapore and Japan. Isabelle Claus Teixeira guides you either way, and most people can practise TRE™ on their own after three to four guided sessions. Book a free discovery call to choose what suits you.

summary.h3: How do I get started with HummingBeing?

div.p: Start with a free discovery call with Isabelle. There is no agenda and no pressure: you talk about how you are feeling and what you are carrying, and she suggests whether TRE™, somatic coaching or mindfulness might suit you. Book a free discovery call and she will arrange a time to speak.
